question: Should Hamelyn solve this as a unified internal refund action backed by Mercado Pago, or change the payment architecture so Stripe owns Mercado Pago refunds directly?
rationale: The code already provides Stripe visibility for Mercado Pago payments, but direct Stripe refunds depend on the chosen payment-processor ownership model and external API capabilities.

options.title: Add MP-backed internal refunds
options.body: Build an admin/backoffice refund action that calls Mercado Pago for the real refund and records or reconciles the refund in Stripe when supported.

options.title: Move to Stripe-native processing
options.body: Rework the payment method so Stripe creates the refundable payment object if the target Mercado Pago/Stripe setup supports it.

options.title: Keep Stripe reporting-only
options.body: Document that Mercado Pago refunds remain operationally separate and must be handled in Mercado Pago or Mercado Libre.

recommendation.title: Add MP-backed internal refunds
recommendation.body: Build an admin/backoffice refund action that calls Mercado Pago for the real refund and records or reconciles the refund in Stripe when supported.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the most recent code and triage context for the current Mercado Pago and Stripe Payment Records integration.
